name: NullCore
description: A mod menu for Geometry Dash.

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: Dark = black menus with white text. Light = white menus with black text. Both use grey outlines.

show-button.name: Show floating button
show-button.description: Show the draggable NullCore button on screen. Tap it to open the menu.

button-size.name: Button size
button-size.description: How big the floating button is.

button-opacity.name: Button opacity
button-opacity.description: How see-through the floating button is.

check-updates.name: Check for updates on startup
check-updates.description: Look for a newer NullCore build when the game starts.
